thread:
Mike R.: Heads-up — planning a small deploy at 13:15 UTC that includes observability tweaks (dashboard panel adjustments + an alert threshold change). Canary on 2 hosts for ~20m.
Anne P.: Who's running the deploy? I can watch the dashboards.
Mike R.: I'll kick it off. @Jen (oncall) can you be standby for rollback and alerts?
Jen (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll be on call. What are the exact smoke checks we want?
Sam D.: Quick checklist: 1) `curl -I /health` on the canary 2) run p95 latency query in Datadog (`avg:trace.http.request.duration.p95{service:inference}`) 3) check error rate (`sum:trace.errors{service:inference}.rollup(sum,60)`) 4) eyeball top traces for new hotspots.
Lina O.: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/inference-overview?orgId=1&from=now-15m — watch panels 'Model latency p95' and 'KV cache hit rate'. I'll follow traces/flamegraph.
Mike R.: Alert tweak: lowering `inference_error_rate` warning from 1.5% -> 1.0% but only on canary config for 20m. YAML snippet I'm pushing to canary config: ```yaml
name: inference_error_rate
expr: sum(rate(errors_total[5m]))/sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) > 0.01
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
Jen (oncall): Please mute global escalation and keep alerts to #eng-oncall for the canary window. Also tag the canary resources with `canary-deploy:1876543210`.
Mike R.: Done — mute + tag applied. Will post canary host IPs when ready. Rolling in ~5m.
observability-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started on host canary-2 (IP 10.2.5.8) — pipeline #456 — https://ci.redwood.example/build/456
Mike R.: Smoke command: `curl -I https://canary-2.redwood.ai/health` should return 200. Also run `./scripts/smoke.sh canary-2` to hit a few sample requests.
Sam D.: Ran `./scripts/smoke.sh canary-2` — all OK. avg latency 120ms, p95 260ms, error rate 0.4%.
Lina O.: Grafana: p95 bumped ~20ms but stable. KV cache hit-rate unchanged. No obvious trace hotspots on flamegraph.
Jen (oncall): I'm keeping strict watch. If error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m we rollback.
Mike R.: Rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --namespace=prod --to-revision=rev-1234`. Also scale canary to 0 after rollback.
Sam D.: :heavy_check_mark: If metrics are stable for +40m we can proceed gradual rollout.
Mike R.: :rocket: Starting gradual rollout now. Will post updates in-thread.
observability-bot: alert-bot: Alert firing: inference_error_rate (canary tag) — value=1.2% — first_fired=1876543480
Jen (oncall): I'm seeing the alert, looking at traces and recent request ids.
Mike R.: I'm scaling back, issuing rollback now.
observability-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback applied by Mike R. — pipeline #456 -> rollback rev-1234
Jen (oncall): Post-rollback checks: p95 returning to baseline, error rate dropping. Holding until stabilized.
Lina O.: Created follow-up ticket to tune sensitivity and add a synthetic check: https://tickets.redwood.example/INFR-789 — will own follow-up.
Mike R.: Thanks all — we'll regroup tomorrow to revisit threshold logic and run a lighter canary.
